from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow metric extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The security/stock code of the company")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label text for the cash flow line item")
    cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of '收到其他与经营活动有关的现金' as reported")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit if specified, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
